headline.en: New papers on automatic mixing, spatial audio generation, and reverb parameter estimation
headline.zh: 新增自动混音、空间音频与混响参数估计论文

summary.en: This week's additions include empirical guidance for two-stage automatic mixing, a reward-based approach for spatial upmixing with audio language models, physics-guided spatial audio generation, and a method for estimating plate reverb parameters, along with symbolic music generation and performance interface papers.
summary.zh: 本周新增了自动混音两阶段设计的实证指导、基于奖励的空间上混音方法、物理引导的空间音频生成、板混响参数估计，以及符号音乐生成和表演界面相关论文。

note.en: Controlled listening experiments show that decomposing automatic mixing into two stages improves perceived full-mix quality.
note.zh: 受控听音实验表明，将自动混音分解为两阶段可提升整体混音感知质量。

note.en: SPHERE uses spatial heuristic rewards to post-train an audio language model for predicting spatial mixing parameters, improving upmixing quality.
note.zh: SPHERE 利用空间启发式奖励对音频语言模型进行后训练，以预测空间混音参数，从而提升上混音质量。

note.en: A two-stage evolutionary search reliably recovers the six physical parameters of a plate reverb from a single impulse response.
note.zh: 两阶段进化搜索方法可从单个冲激响应中可靠恢复板混响的六个物理参数。
